verdict.rationale: Featurebase is a feedback-management product, so turning feedback into proposed tasks is a fair axis. The evidence shows only adjacent AI features: AI that helps 'declutter & find the most impactful opportunities', the Fibi support agent, and AI search answers. Nothing documents AI converting a plain-language feedback description into a structured set of proposed tasks.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have AI turn a plain-language feedback description into a structured set of proposed tasks
